title: Jesus Feeds Five Thousand
summary: Jesus Feeds Five Thousand follows a real Bible moment about provision. Jesus can use small gifts and provide more than enough. When what you have seems too small to help, this story shows that Jesus can use little gifts generously offered.

read_it.prompt: Read John 6:1-14 slowly and listen for the choice, promise, warning, or rescue in the story.

tell_it: Jesus fed a huge crowd with a small lunch. A boy had five loaves and two fish. Jesus gave thanks and fed a huge crowd with leftovers.
understand_it: Jesus can use small gifts and provide more than enough. Jesus Feeds Five Thousand also shows that provision has a shape in real life, not only in Bible vocabulary.
age_5_7_explanation: Jesus fed a huge crowd with a small lunch.
age_8_11_explanation: A boy had five loaves and two fish. Jesus gave thanks and fed a huge crowd with leftovers. Kids can notice provision in the choices people make, not only in the famous part of the story. Jesus can use small gifts and provide more than enough.
teen_explanation: Jesus can use small gifts and provide more than enough. When what you have seems too small to help, this story shows that Jesus can use little gifts generously offered. Teens can also notice the tension in the passage: faith is not always easy, immediate, or admired by everyone nearby.
key_truths: Jesus can use small gifts and provide more than enough.
Jesus Feeds Five Thousand shows provision through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.

life_application: When what you have seems too small to help, this story shows that Jesus can use little gifts generously offered.

quiz_questions.question: Which answer belongs to Jesus Feeds Five Thousand?
choices: The boy fed everyone by himself
quiz_questions.explanation: Five loaves and two fish is the correct answer. The detail matters because it keeps the lesson tied to John 6:1-14, not just a general idea.

activity.instructions: Draw twelve baskets and fill them with ways small kindness can serve others.
